title: Claim result
description: Output of the claim checker (POST /claims/check). Produced by Member A, displayed by C.

decomposition.description: Whether the claim was split by a model through Bifrost or by deterministic rules.

evidence.description: registry = signed Evidence Registry only; registry_and_live = plus figures Tavily found just now.

registry_hash.description: Hash of the signed registry version used; null if no version has been published yet.

counts.description: What the claim itself says it counts.

verdict.description: supported: a current source agrees within 1.5x. overstated/understated: above the highest or below the lowest source by more than 1.5x. outdated: only superseded sources agree. unsupported: no figure, not per prompt, or between sources with none agreeing.

claimed.description: The figure parsed from the claim, normalised to mL or Wh.

registry_factors.description: factor_id values from the registry used to judge this atomic claim.
